playbookOutput.executionSummary: detects gibberish or trolling by isolating irrelevant inputs into a final priority case. On the first instance, the bot acknowledges the remark and uses a hard pivot to restate the technical directive; on the second, it automatically triggers a transfer to an agent via ${FLOW:bell_aqd}. This prevents infinite loops and ensures the bot only entertains non-sequiturs for a maximum of one turn before escalating.
